learning_outcomes.text: Analyze the formation mechanisms of alloys and phase diagrams; interpret phase transformations (eutectic, eutectoid, etc.) occurring at different temperatures and compositions on graphs.

Explain the internal structures of steels and cast irons using the iron-carbon equilibrium diagram; evaluate the effects of heat treatment processes (quenching, tempering, etc.) and TTT diagrams on microstructure.
Distinguish the basic characteristics of plastics, ceramics, and composites, in addition to metallic materials; grasp strengthening mechanisms such as age hardening in non-ferrous metals.

Define the behavior of materials under environmental effects and corrosion mechanisms; apply corrosion protection methods to engineering problems by selecting appropriate materials for the intended use.

syllabus_topics: Solid solution. Solubility. Concept of alloy.
Concept of solubility (partial and full solubility). Equilibrium diagrams.
Iron-carbon equilibrium diagram and phase transformations. Short exam.
Phase transformations. Heat treatment of steels.
Corrosion and its types. Corrosion protection methods. Short exam.
Engineering materials. Properties of non-metallic materials.
bibliography: W.D.Callister, Malzeme Bilimi ve Mühendisliği 2013, Nobel yayınları
